Alex: Quick ask — can we carve 30m this week for a focused perf sync on the latest inference numbers? want a short readout + action list.
Maria: +1. prefer short, concrete agenda.
Chao: I'm free Thu 9am-10am PT or Wed 4pm PT. either works.
Jamie: Wed 9am PT is rough for me, Thu 9am PT ok.
Sarah: I'll coordinate calendar if we pick a slot. prefer Thu so infra can repro experiments.
Alex: Proposed agenda (short):
```
1) 5m - TL;DR: cost vs latency delta from last deploy (Maria)
2) 10m - latency distribution + tail behavior (Maria)
3) 8m - quantization & kernel changes impact (Jamie)
4) 5m - batching/caching experiments + suggested config (Chao)
5) 2m - actions / owners (all)
```
Maria: I'll post the latest dashboard and 90/95/99 pcts beforehand. link: https://dash.redwood.internal/perf/infer/latest (view-only).
Chao: I'll attach the cost breakdown and a tiny script to reproduce the batch test: `rperf run --suite batch-a --steps 1000 --profile cost`.
Jamie: I'll demo before/after timings for int8 kernels (small snippet): `python tools/bench/compare.py --model open-7b --quant int8`.
Alex: Can everyone drop pre-reads by Wed EOD so we don't grind time at the sync?
Sarah: Polling options: Thu 9:00 PT (option A), Wed 16:00 PT (option B). I'll create a Doodle if needed.
Maria: Pre-reads: I can share CSVs and a couple Grafana panels. will tag relevant dashboards.
